english.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose choice when someone is unaware of a fact or situation.
Use 唔知 as the all-purpose everyday choice when someone lacks information or is unaware of a fact.

examples.english: I am ignorant of whether he took leave today.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 gam1 jat6 ceng2 zo2 gaa2

examples.english: I was unaware that he took today off.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 gam1 jat6 ceng2 zo2 gaa2
